_about: The boardwalk: summer money, the piers, the games of chance.

scenes.title: The wheel on Hunt's Pier
scenes.text: The big wheel at Hunt's Pier is rigged to stop on twelve, which is fine; it has always been rigged. {man.call}, who runs it for you, has been rigging it to stop on twelve a little more often than you agreed, and pocketing the difference. A sailor from Cape May lost his whole paycheck and is telling the boardwalk cop about it.

choices.label: Give the sailor his money back, and fine {man.first} double
Let the cop handle the sailor
choices.hint: The cop is on the pad. Mostly.
choices.result: The sailor was put on the last bus to Cape May with a warning and a hot dog.
choices.failText: The cop's sergeant was on the boards that night. It went in a report.

choices.label: Recognize {man.first} at the table: he earns
choices.hint: Greedy men work hardest when they're praised.

scenes.title: The singer at the Riptide wants paying
scenes.text: A crooner from Philadelphia, two records on the charts, played three weeks at the Riptide on {capo.first}'s word. {capo.first} paid him for one. Now the crooner's manager, a large man named Bruno, is at your door with a contract and a cousin.

opinion.why: Paid my debt and made me look small

choices.label: Make {capo.first} pay it out of his end
choices.result: {capo.first} paid. Bruno shook your hand. The singer is booked again next summer.
choices.failText: {capo.first} said he did not have it, and meant he would not. You paid, and he sulked.

choices.label: Send Bruno and his cousin home
choices.hint: A singer can always sing somewhere else.

scenes.title: The Weather Bureau says Donna is coming
scenes.text: The radio says a hurricane called Donna will come up the coast by Monday. The Boardwalk merchants are boarding windows. {capo.call} wants to know: do we keep the games open for the last weekend of tourists, or pull the cash and close?

choices.label: Pull the cash, close the games, sandbag the bars

opinion.why: The boss looked after us in the storm

crew.why: The boss looked after us in the storm

choices.label: Stay open: the last weekend is the best weekend

opinion.why: Kept us out in a hurricane

choices.result: Donna turned out to sea at the last minute. The boardwalk had its best Saturday of the year.
choices.failText: Donna did not turn. The Ferris wheel on the pier is in the bay.
